objective: Create a verifiable hospitality procurement wedge and investor-ready evidence package within six months.

milestones.name: Truth baseline and release control
exitCriteria: One canonical checkout, branch and live release identity recorded
Strict build and test failures classified by owner
Auth authority decision recorded
No production deployment while a release blocker remains

milestones.name: Design-partner wedge
exitCriteria: Three hotel procurement interviews with named operational pain and current workflow evidence
Ten supplier interviews in one geographic/category wedge
Signed letters of intent or pilot commitments from at least two hotels
Baseline procurement metrics captured before product claims

milestones.name: Trustworthy transaction slice
exitCriteria: Hotel catalog to fixed-price PO to approval to delivery receipt works in isolated test tenant
Tenant and permission matrix passes 401/403/cross-tenant tests
Payment-guarantee and Authority Matrix gates are enforced
POD is idempotent, audited and assignment-scoped
ETA integration is sandbox/mocked and invisible to public UI

milestones.name: Pilot operations and supply density
exitCriteria: Two hotels reorder through the same category wedge
Twenty verified suppliers with current price/quantity/lead-time records
At least 30 completed orders with delivery and exception data
Repeat-order rate, fill rate, on-time rate and contribution margin measured

milestones.name: Regulatory and financing readiness
exitCriteria: ETA invoice lifecycle tested against official integration requirements
Factoring partner and license boundary documented
No financing promise appears without partner-approved terms and eligibility wording
Fees, consent, dispute, refund and data-retention terms approved

milestones.name: Investor / strategic-sale packet
exitCriteria: Cohort retention and repeat GMV are measured, not forecast-only
Contribution margin and acquisition payback are reconciled to source data
Security, tenant isolation, deployment and incident evidence are packaged
Buyer/investor diligence room contains product, contracts, metrics and known risks
